0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-10, 0-6 at home, on a four-game losing streak) host the Portland Trail Blazers (8-3, winners of two straight, 5-1 on the road) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, which is the Kings' 12th of the season. Sacramento trails the season series 0-1 after losing 128-120 at home on October 23, and it lost all four meetings in 2025-26. Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated) are out for Sacramento, and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Portland is without Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle).
